en.title: Decimal to Binary Converter — Coding.Tools
en.description: Convert decimal numbers to binary format directly in your browser.
en.toolDescription: Convert decimal numbers to binary, hex, and octal.
descParas: This tool converts decimal (base 10) numbers to binary (base 2), and also shows hex and octal equivalents.
The conversion runs locally in your browser.
steps: Type or paste a decimal number into the input field.
Click Convert to see the binary, hex, and octal results.
Use Copy to copy the result.
whatIsParas: Converting decimal to binary is fundamental in computer science and digital electronics.
en.exampleCode:
--- Decimal Input ---
255

--- Binary ---
11111111

--- Hex ---
FF

--- Octal ---
377

cn.title: 十进制转二进制转换器 — Coding.Tools
cn.description: 在浏览器中直接将十进制数字转换为二进制格式。
cn.toolDescription: 将十进制数字转换为二进制、十六进制和八进制。

cn.descTitle: 十进制转二进制转换器
descParas: 此工具将十进制（基数10）数字转换为二进制（基数2），同时显示十六进制和八进制等价值。
转换在浏览器本地运行。
steps: 输入或粘贴十进制数字。
点击转换查看结果。
使用复制复制结果。
